# TehWiz Productions

> Sovereign edge AI, cognitive architecture, games, security, and agent infrastructure lab founded by Michael Scott Hoyt. On-device AI companions, game engines, and developer tooling. © 2026 ISICECAKEOISIS INC.

## Flagship: Yuli

- [Yuli Engine Architecture](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/yuli): Autonomous cognitive persona engine running on an F₂⁴ Boolean hypercube state space; real-time MBTI personality-pattern detection; 70–110 TPS on mobile WebGPU with sub-200ms time-to-first-token. BSL 1.1 licensed.
- [Yuli Web App](https://yuli.tehwiz.com/): In-browser WebGPU live beta (canonical launch).

## Games

- [Ramen Nights & Budget Bites](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/ramen-nights): Tokyo University economics capstone — build a ramen franchise across five Tokyo districts. Zero-dependency HTML5 Canvas with Web Audio chiptunes.
- [Ramen Nights on Itch.io](https://tehwiz.itch.io/ramen-nights-and-budget-bites): Free download ($1 recommended donation).
- [F.U.N.](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/fun): 4-player trick-taking card game with solitaire speed-race finale. 100% client-side. Play at https://fun.tehwiz.com
- [Realm Raiders](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/raiders): Asymmetric fantasy realm management on living parchment; async PvP catapult sieges. Play at https://raiders.tehwiz.com
- [Bleep](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/bleep): Mechanical stepper slot simulation in React 19 + Pixi.js v8. MIT licensed. Play at https://bleep.tehwiz.com

## Security & Infrastructure

- [KISS AV](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/kissav): Obfuscated Rust AFK security daemon with native network killswitch. GPL v3. Live at https://kissav.tehwiz.com
- [Terminally Skilled](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/terminally-skilled): Multi-asset agentic financial MUD over MCP + REST; Season 1 live. Live at https://terminallyskilled.rest
- [Purple Canary](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/purple-canary): Forensic substance screening suite. Companion e-book at https://book.purplecanarylab.com
- [ISICECAKEOISIS](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/isicecakeoisis): Corporate holding — Business-to-Agent systems architecture. Live at https://isicecakeoisis.com

## Redirects

- [Tricks Wiki](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/tricks-wiki): tricks.wiki now 301-redirects to tehwiz.com. Redirect pointer, no external launch.
- [Alchememe](https://tehwiz.com/blog/alchememe-sunset-postmortem): alchememe.com now redirects to the sunset postmortem.
- [Cherry SunDays](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/cherry-sundays): cherrysundays.com now redirects to tehwiz.com.
